i.command: if true; then launchctl load /tmp/x.plist; fi
for i in 1; do launchctl load /tmp/x.plist; done
while true; do launchctl load /tmp/x.plist; break; done
case x in x) launchctl load /tmp/x.plist;; esac
launchctl print gui/501; launchctl kickstart gui/501/x
launchctl bootout gui/501/x ; launchctl bootstrap gui/501 /tmp/x.plist
osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "launchctl load /tmp/x.plist"'

osascript <<E
do shell script "launchctl load /tmp/x.plist"
E
swift -e 'import Foundation; let p=Process(); p.launchPath="/bin/launchctl"; p.arguments=["load","/tmp/x.plist"]; p.launch()'
echo "use launchctl to load the agent"
git commit -m "docs: launchctl load is deprecated, use bootstrap"
launchctl list > /tmp/jobs.txt; wc -l /tmp/jobs.txt; npm run start
gh issue create --title "launchctl load fails" --body "launchctl bootstrap gui/501 x.plist returns 5"
gh pr comment 12 --body 'we call launchctl bootstrap in the installer'
launchctl list | grep com.floorboss | xargs rm
launchctl list | grep com.floorboss | xargs launchctl load
launchctl list | grep com.floorboss | xargs -I{} launchctl bootstrap gui/501 {}
launchctl print gui/501/com.floorboss.brief | xargs launchctl load
launchctl print gui/501/com.floorboss.brief | xargs -I{} launchctl bootstrap gui/501 {}
launchctl print gui/501/com.floorboss.brief; launchctl kickstart gui/501/com.floorboss.brief
launchctl list | grep com.floorboss | xargs launchctl start
launchctl list | grep com.floorboss | awk '{print $3}' | xargs launchctl start
osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "node @ROOT/scripts/unattended.mjs install-brief --yes"'

cat <<E > notes.md
Run launchctl load /tmp/x.plist to install
E
gh issue comment 3 --body "run `launchctl load /tmp/x.plist` in your terminal"
git -c core.editor=vim commit -m "launchctl enable works now"
